_comment: Merge into ~/.cursor/hooks.json (or a project's .cursor/hooks.json). The hook is claude/hooks/envh_ask.py; it reads both tools' formats and decides for itself, printing nothing for commands it has no opinion on. Do NOT add a command-text 'matcher': a substring match for 'envh' skips commands where bash reconstructs the name (e""nvh, $'\x65nvh'), so the hook must run on every beforeShellExecution, as the Claude Code side runs on every Bash command.
